_comment: Foreign Affairs (src/engine/diplomacy.py). Off-map powers that are not at war: they trade, sell arms and choose sides.
alignment: ONE score per power, -100 (firmly with the Vosk Hegemony) .. +100 (firmly with Kestria). It drifts
drift_per_week back toward starting_alignment; envoys, battles, sunk freighters, events and the Hotline move it.
alignment_floor / alignment_ceiling: how far ideology lets it go either way, whatever the gifts.
preferences: tax_policy {policy: alignment per week} (Oakhaven despises oppressive taxes); victory_weight
multiplies the swing a won battle gives (Tor respects strength).
trade: a trade agreement adds trade_income_bonus_cr CR/week while one of the partner's ports is open. Kestria may
sign at alignment >= trade_min_alignment, the Vosk at alignment <= -trade_min_alignment; the power cancels
when it drifts back past trade_cancel_alignment (toward the other side).
lend_lease_inventory: {id, item (equipment id), quantity, cost_cr, min_alignment, delivery_weeks[, name]}. Kestria
buys at alignment >= min_alignment, the Vosk at alignment <= -min_alignment. Convoys sail to the first open
port (ports), wait at sea while all are blockaded, and may be torpedoed by enemy wolfpacks at sea.
gift: an envoy costs gift_cost CR and swings alignment by up to gift_gain toward the sender (less as it nears 100).
Faction texts and inventories after the design team's faction sheet (Oakhaven, Tor, Vael).

OAKHAVEN.name: The Oakhaven Republic
OAKHAVEN.description: A wealthy naval superpower dominating the western ocean. They prefer democracies and are disgusted by high civilian taxes or oppression. They offer high-tech gear.

TOR.name: United Provinces of Tor
TOR.description: A sprawling, heavily industrialized autocracy to the south. They care little for the suffering of Kestria's citizens, but respect military strength.

VAEL.name: Sovereign State of Vael
VAEL.description: A fiercely neutral scientific hub. They refuse to sell weapons of war, but their medical and engineering expertise is unmatched.
